events.title: New Demo Now and Steam Next Fest Soon!
events.summary: Well hello Toadies!We haven't made an update since our big expo at GDC in March. Since then, we've added a bunch of new features and polish to Toadled!For example, our MOST requested feature... A Volume Slider!I kid you not, one out of every 2-3 testers would look for a volume slider when they first started the game. events.title: Devlog #1 - Items Galore
events.summary: Greetings, Toadlers! 💚 Game designer Josh here. I’d like to tell you about one of the biggest and most exciting changes we’ve introduced to Toadled: Eating Frenzy over the past year: items. Items improve various parts of your game. You get to choose or upgrade one item halfway through each level, and then again when you beat the level.
